critical_findings.finding: Holding for two seconds and Hold to submit depend on department configuration. Normal mode uses ordinary submission; Current on quick buttons is accessibility text/ring, not guaranteed literal paint.
Set Active saves incident selection then opens status selection with call preselected; unit status has not yet been submitted.
Manual route check-in substitutes0,0 without device fix; software state change is not physical-arrival proof.
Pause/resume/cancel/acknowledge functions exist in API/store but are not invoked by current rendered route controls. Cancelled history text and Acknowledge badge are state displays.
Acknowledge is conditional badge text only, with no onPress action in DeviationCard.
End Route confirmation uses native Alert; browser confirmation/completion requires actual verification or separately authorized retained compatibility fix.
Complete and Cancel count use native Alert. Do not treat a web button click as posted adjustments. Controlled-item witness remains a separate web workflow.
Zone action routes with zoneName/zoneId. New-call source does not consume these params; no coordinate or recipient prefill can be claimed.
Unit already has a real web map event/camera adapter and HtmlRenderer.web; Responder installed-SDK/WebView failures do not establish Unit failures.
Lock/unlock are icon accessible names. Need actual DOM control boxes plus separate screenshot review; never append semantic names to literal visible_labels.
Audio Settings and Disconnect belong to connected view; empty picker does not support claiming those controls or hardware/provider success.
Unit writes crew/individual time and usage/expenses and can draft F42; it intentionally does not offer supervisor time approval.
Checklist web vault is memory-only; native uses device-only keys/envelopes. Other feature offline behavior must be inspected separately.
Add passkey is conditional and credential changes are outside this recording authorization.

Route fixture with assigned Engine51, actual pending→InProgress→Completed/Skipped stop states and genuine history; observe native-alert boundary for End Route.
Independent compartment/whole-unit counts with serialized+bulk examples, server-save proof and actual completion/cancellation/witness boundary.
Unit04 map/layers/indoor/weather/references/chat/voice availability/records/deployment/settings views; use each real source component and state.
native_browser_limits: Unit uses its own mapbox.web and HtmlRenderer.web; do not assume Responder failures or blindly copy its adapters.
Native Alert is used for End Route and inventory completion/cancellation; actual web failure is not yet observed by this audit.
Deselect already has a web window.confirm fallback; logout uses the existing Unit confirmation UI.
Physical GPS/geofence/arrival, microphone/BT/PTT/push/background delivery remain untested and permission prompts must not be accepted.
Checklist web vault is memory-only; Records offline support is definition-specific; inventory count progress uses server requests.
Voice Audio Settings/Disconnect require an actual connected provider session, outside current no-provider authorization.
